parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: Describe the image you want to create, or how to edit your reference images. Plain, natural language works well.

parameters.name: referenceImages
parameters.description: Images to edit or build from (up to 10). Required if you provide a mask.
parameters.array_note: Pass an array, even for a single value — a bare value is ignored.

parameters.name: mask
parameters.description: An optional PNG that marks which parts of the first reference image to change. It uses transparency: fully transparent areas are edited, fully opaque areas are kept. Export a PNG with real transparency (don't flatten it). If you've drawn a white-on-black mask, convert the white "edit" areas to transparent first.

parameters.name: numOutputs
parameters.description: How many images to create from the same prompt (1-10).

parameters.name: quality
parameters.description: How much effort goes into the image. Higher levels look better but cost more; Auto lets the model choose.

parameters.name: background
parameters.description: Whether the background is solid (Opaque) or see-through (Transparent). Auto lets the model decide.

next_step.instructions: Optional: prompt_spark rewrites a short or underspecified prompt into an on-model one — pass your draft or the user intent as prompt (model_id is required), then use its recommended_call.parameters as the model_run parameters, as-is or edited. Skip it when the user wants their exact prompt used verbatim.
